label: Query Builder Method
description: Calls a documented fluent QueryBuilder method on a Core\Database instance.

properties.name: result_variable
properties.label: Result variable
properties.help: Optional PHP variable name. Omit the $ sign. Leave blank to use the automatic node-specific name.

methods.name: table
methods.label: Set Table
methods.description: Sets the table used by the fluent query and returns the builder.
methods.help:
Sets the table used by the fluent query and returns the builder.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->get();
```

methods.name: from
methods.label: Set FROM Table
methods.description: Sets the table through the from() alias and returns the builder.
methods.help:
Sets the table through the from() alias and returns the builder.

### Example

```php
$db->from('posts')->where('published', 1)->get();
```

methods.name: select
methods.label: Select Columns
methods.description: Replaces the selected columns. Connect an Array node; values are unpacked as variadic arguments.
methods.help:
Replaces the selected columns. Connect an Array node; values are unpacked as variadic arguments.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->select('id', 'name', 'email')->get();
```

methods.name: selectRaw
methods.label: Select Raw Expression
methods.description: Adds a raw SELECT expression with optional prepared bindings.
methods.help:
Adds a raw SELECT expression with optional prepared bindings.

### Example

```php
$db->table('orders')->selectRaw('SUM(amount) AS total')->first();
```

methods.name: where
methods.label: WHERE
methods.description: Adds a basic WHERE condition. Use the second input as the value for shorthand equality.
methods.help:
Adds a basic WHERE condition. Use the second input as the value for shorthand equality.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->where('status', 'active')->get();
```

methods.name: orWhere
methods.label: OR WHERE
methods.description: Adds an OR WHERE condition with shorthand equality support.
methods.help:
Adds an OR WHERE condition with shorthand equality support.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->where('role', 'admin')->orWhere('role', 'moderator')->get();
```

methods.name: whereRaw
methods.label: Raw WHERE
methods.description: Adds a raw WHERE clause with prepared bindings.
methods.help:
Adds a raw WHERE clause with prepared bindings.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->whereRaw('age BETWEEN ? AND ?', [18, 30])->get();
```

methods.name: orWhereRaw
methods.label: Raw OR WHERE
methods.description: Adds a raw OR WHERE clause with prepared bindings.
methods.help:
Adds a raw OR WHERE clause with prepared bindings.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->where('active', 1)->orWhereRaw('LENGTH(name) > ?', [10])->get();
```

methods.name: whereIn
methods.label: WHERE IN
methods.description: Adds a WHERE IN condition from an array of values.
methods.help:
Adds a WHERE IN condition from an array of values.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->whereIn('id', [1, 2, 3])->get();
```

methods.name: whereNull
methods.label: WHERE NULL
methods.description: Adds an IS NULL condition.
methods.help:
Adds an IS NULL condition.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->whereNull('deleted_at')->get();
```

methods.name: whereBetween
methods.label: WHERE BETWEEN
methods.description: Adds a BETWEEN condition using a two-value array.
methods.help:
Adds a BETWEEN condition using a two-value array.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->whereBetween('age', [18, 30])->get();
```

methods.name: whereNested
methods.label: Nested WHERE Group
methods.description: Adds grouped nested conditions through a Closure receiving the nested builder.
methods.help:
Adds grouped nested conditions through a Closure receiving the nested builder.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->whereNested(function ($q) { $q->where('role', 'admin'); })->get();
```

methods.name: join
methods.label: JOIN
methods.description: Adds an INNER or custom JOIN.
methods.help:
Adds an INNER or custom JOIN.

### Example

```php
$db->table('posts')->join('users', 'posts.user_id', '=', 'users.id')->get();
```

methods.name: leftJoin
methods.label: LEFT JOIN
methods.description: Adds a LEFT JOIN.
methods.help:
Adds a LEFT JOIN.

### Example

```php
$db->table('posts')->leftJoin('comments', 'posts.id', '=', 'comments.post_id')->get();
```

methods.name: rightJoin
methods.label: RIGHT JOIN
methods.description: Adds a RIGHT JOIN.
methods.help:
Adds a RIGHT JOIN.

### Example

```php
$db->table('posts')->rightJoin('authors', 'posts.author_id', '=', 'authors.id')->get();
```

methods.name: orderBy
methods.label: ORDER BY
methods.description: Adds an ORDER BY clause.
methods.help:
Adds an ORDER BY clause.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->orderBy('created_at', 'DESC')->get();
```

methods.name: orderByRaw
methods.label: Raw ORDER BY
methods.description: Adds a raw ORDER BY expression.
methods.help:
Adds a raw ORDER BY expression.

### Example

```php
$db->table('tasks')->orderByRaw('priority DESC')->get();
```

methods.name: groupBy
methods.label: GROUP BY
methods.description: Sets GROUP BY columns. Connect an Array node; values are unpacked.
methods.help:
Sets GROUP BY columns. Connect an Array node; values are unpacked.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->selectRaw('role, COUNT(*) AS total')->groupBy('role')->get();
```

methods.name: having
methods.label: HAVING
methods.description: Adds a HAVING condition after grouping.
methods.help:
Adds a HAVING condition after grouping.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->selectRaw('role, COUNT(*) AS total')->groupBy('role')->having('total', '>', 5)->get();
```

methods.name: limit
methods.label: LIMIT
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of rows returned.
methods.help:
Sets the maximum number of rows returned.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->limit(10)->get();
```

methods.name: offset
methods.label: OFFSET
methods.description: Sets how many rows to skip.
methods.help:
Sets how many rows to skip.

### Example

```php
$db->table('users')->limit(10)->offset(20)->get();
```

methods.name: paginate
methods.label: Paginate
methods.description: Executes a paginated SELECT and returns rows plus pagination metadata.
methods.help:
Executes a paginated SELECT and returns rows plus pagination metadata.

### Example

```php
$page = $db->table('posts')->paginate(20, 1);
```

methods.name: get
methods.label: Get Rows
methods.description: Executes the SELECT query and returns an array of row objects.
methods.help:
Executes the SELECT query and returns an array of row objects.

### Example

```php
$users = $db->table('users')->where('active', 1)->get();
```

methods.name: first
methods.label: Get First Row
methods.description: Returns the first row object or null.
methods.help:
Returns the first row object or null.

### Example

```php
$user = $db->table('users')->where('id', 1)->first();
```

methods.name: count
methods.label: Count Rows
methods.description: Counts rows or non-null values in a selected column.
methods.help:
Counts rows or non-null values in a selected column.

### Example

```php
$total = $db->table('users')->count();
```

methods.name: insert
methods.label: Insert Row
methods.description: Inserts one row into the selected table.
methods.help:
Inserts one row into the selected table.

### Example

```php
$ok = $db->table('users')->insert(['name' => 'John']);
```

methods.name: update
methods.label: Update Rows
methods.description: Updates matching rows and returns the affected-row count.
methods.help:
Updates matching rows and returns the affected-row count.

### Example

```php
$count = $db->table('users')->where('id', 5)->update(['active' => 0]);
```

methods.name: delete
methods.label: Delete Rows
methods.description: Deletes matching rows and returns the affected-row count. Without a WHERE clause, every row is deleted.
methods.help:
Deletes matching rows and returns the affected-row count. Without a WHERE clause, every row is deleted.

### Example

```php
$count = $db->table('users')->where('id', 10)->delete();
```

methods.name: upsert
methods.label: Upsert Rows
methods.description: Inserts or updates rows using database-specific conflict handling.
methods.help:
Inserts or updates rows using database-specific conflict handling.

### Example

```php
$count = $db->table('users')->upsert($rows, ['email'], ['name']);
```

methods.name: union
methods.label: UNION
methods.description: Combines this query with another builder or Closure.
methods.help:
Combines this query with another builder or Closure.

### Example

```php
$first->union($second)->get();
```

methods.name: unionAll
methods.label: UNION ALL
methods.description: Combines this query with another builder or Closure using UNION ALL.
methods.help:
Combines this query with another builder or Closure using UNION ALL.

### Example

```php
$first->unionAll($second)->get();
```

methods.name: raw
methods.label: Execute Raw SQL
methods.description: Executes prepared raw SQL. SELECT-like statements return object results; write statements return affected rows.
methods.help:
Executes prepared raw SQL. SELECT-like statements return object results; write statements return affected rows.

### Example

```php
$rows = $db->raw('SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = ?', [1]);
```

methods.name: toSql
methods.label: Build SQL
methods.description: Builds the current SQL string without executing it.
methods.help:
Builds the current SQL string without executing it.

### Example

```php
$sql = $db->table('users')->where('active', 1)->toSql();
```

methods.name: getBindings
methods.label: Get Bindings
methods.description: Returns the prepared bindings accumulated by the builder.
methods.help:
Returns the prepared bindings accumulated by the builder.

### Example

```php
$bindings = $db->getBindings();
```

methods.name: getRawBindings
methods.label: Get Raw Bindings
methods.description: Returns the bindings in their raw internal order.
methods.help:
Returns the bindings in their raw internal order.

### Example

```php
$bindings = $db->getRawBindings();
```

methods.name: reset
methods.label: Reset Builder
methods.description: Clears the current query state and returns the builder.
methods.help:
Clears the current query state and returns the builder.

### Example

```php
$db->reset()->table('users')->get();
```

methods.name: getLastInsertId
methods.label: Last Insert ID
methods.description: Returns the most recent QueryBuilder insert ID.
methods.help:
Returns the most recent QueryBuilder insert ID.

### Example

```php
$id = $db->getLastInsertId();
```

methods.name: getAffectedRows
methods.label: Affected Rows
methods.description: Returns the affected rows from the most recent write operation.
methods.help:
Returns the affected rows from the most recent write operation.

### Example

```php
$count = $db->getAffectedRows();
```

methods.name: getLastError
methods.label: Last Error Message
methods.description: Returns the latest QueryBuilder error message or null.
methods.help:
Returns the latest QueryBuilder error message or null.

### Example

```php
$error = $db->getLastError();
```

methods.name: getLastErrorCode
methods.label: Last Error Code
methods.description: Returns the latest driver error code or null.
methods.help:
Returns the latest driver error code or null.

### Example

```php
$code = $db->getLastErrorCode();
```

methods.name: getLastSqlState
methods.label: Last SQLSTATE
methods.description: Returns the latest SQLSTATE value or null.
methods.help:
Returns the latest SQLSTATE value or null.

### Example

```php
$state = $db->getLastSqlState();
```
